# Imports
```{r}
if(!require("deSolve")) install.packages("deSolve")
library("deSolve")
```

### SIR model
```{r}
SIR_model <- function(time, state, params){
  S <- state["S"] # susceptible population
  I <- state["I"] # infected population
  alpha <- params["alpha"] # rate at which infected host leaves this class (dies or recovers)
  beta <- params["beta"] # rate at which susceptible becomes infected (increase of infected pop)
  K <- params["K"] # carrying capacity, max pop size of a specific population, given by r/alpha, intrinsic growth rate divided by the coeff of intraspecific competition"
  r <- params["r"] # intrinsic growth rate of the population
  
  dS <- (r * (1 - (S/K))) * S - (beta * S * I)
  dI <- (beta * S * I) - (alpha * I)
  
  return(list(c(dS, dI)))
}
```

### Parameters definition
```{r}
state <- c(S=2, I=0.1)
params <- c(
  alpha=0.2,
  beta=0.5,
  K=2,
  r=1
)
time <- seq(0, 50, by = 1)
out <- ode(
  state,
  time,
  SIR_model,
  params
)
df.out <- as.data.frame(out)
plot(
  df.out$I~df.out$S,
  xlab="S",
  ylab="I",
  #xlim=c(0, 1.5),
  #ylim=c(0,5)
  )
abline(v = epid_thresh, col = "blue")
abline(a = 1/0.5, b = (-1/(2*0.5)), col = "red")

```
